test_cases.title: Valid unexpired token restores session across refresh without showing Login
test_cases.given: a valid, unexpired token is present in localStorage before App.jsx mounts
test_cases.then: isAuthenticated is initialized to true, Login is not rendered, and the previously active view re-renders

test_cases.title: No stored token renders Login and issues zero protected data-fetch calls
test_cases.given: no token exists in localStorage (first visit or previously cleared)
test_cases.then: isAuthenticated is initialized to false, Login is rendered within 100ms of mount, and no GET /api/dashboard/stats or GET /api/users request is issued

test_cases.title: Expired stored token clears storage and redirects to Login with session-expired message
test_cases.given: a token is present in localStorage but its exp claim is in the past
test_cases.when: App.jsx mounts and performs the jwt-decode expiry check
test_cases.then: the token is cleared, isAuthenticated is set to false, and sessionExpiredMessage is set to 'Your session has expired. Please log in again.'

test_cases.title: 401 on a mid-session API call clears token and redirects to Login (same as expiry)
test_cases.given: the Admin is authenticated on the Users view and calls updateUser, which the backend rejects with 401
test_cases.then: clearAuthToken is called, the registered unauthorized handler fires, isAuthenticated becomes false, and sessionExpiredMessage is set (not a generic/opaque error toast)

test_cases.title: Malformed/unparseable token is treated as no token, not a crash
test_cases.given: localStorage holds a string that is not a valid JWT
test_cases.when: App.jsx mounts and jwt-decode throws while parsing it
test_cases.then: isAuthenticated is set to false with no uncaught exception and no stack trace surfaced to the user

test_cases.title: localStorage.getItem throwing is treated as no token
test_cases.given: localStorage.getItem is mocked to throw (e.g. storage disabled)
test_cases.when: getStoredToken() is called during App.jsx mount
test_cases.then: getStoredToken returns null (throw is not propagated) and isAuthenticated is set to false

test_cases.title: localStorage.setItem throwing surfaces a readable error, not a raw stack trace
test_cases.given: localStorage.setItem is mocked to throw (e.g. quota exceeded)
test_cases.when: setAuthToken(token) is called after a successful login
test_cases.then: the error is caught and a readable, non-stack-trace error condition is surfaced rather than an uncaught exception

test_cases.title: Request interceptor attaches Authorization header only when a token is present
test_cases.given: a token is stored via setAuthToken
test_cases.when: any userApi.js HTTP call is made (e.g. getUsers)
test_cases.then: the outgoing request carries an Authorization: Bearer <token> header; when no token is stored, no Authorization header is attached

test_cases.title: Unauthorized handler does not fire twice when two in-flight requests both 401 after token already cleared
test_cases.given: two protected requests are in-flight and both receive 401; the first response clears the token
test_cases.when: the second 401 response arrives after the token is already null
test_cases.then: the registered unauthorized handler is invoked exactly once, not twice (no duplicate redirect/message reset)

test_cases.title: sessionExpiredMessage is threaded to LoginScreen as sessionExpiredMessage prop, never as authError
test_cases.given: a 401 or expiry event has set sessionExpiredMessage to a non-null string in App.jsx
test_cases.then: LoginScreen receives a sessionExpiredMessage prop with that value and receives no authError prop

test_cases.title: Auth-state check on mount completes within the 100ms budget
test_cases.given: a valid token is present in localStorage
test_cases.when: App.jsx mounts 100 times in a benchmark loop, measuring time from mount to isAuthenticated being set
test_cases.then: p95 latency is < 100ms across the 100 iterations

test_cases.title: No password or password hash is ever written to localStorage or any client-persistent storage
test_cases.given: a successful login has occurred and setAuthToken has been called
test_cases.when: localStorage contents are inspected after login
test_cases.then: only the opaque JWT is present under the auth-token key; no password, password hash, or other credential material is present anywhere in localStorage

test_cases.title: Session-expiry event is logged with no PII on 401 or on-mount expiry detection
test_cases.given: a 401 response is received or an expired token is detected on mount
test_cases.then: a client-side auth_session_expired event is logged with no token value, no email, and no other PII in its payload

test_cases.title: sessionExpiredMessage renders in an aria-live region on the Login screen after redirect
test_cases.given: sessionExpiredMessage is set to a non-null string and LoginScreen is rendered
test_cases.when: an axe-core / DOM scan inspects the rendered Login screen
test_cases.then: the message text appears inside an aria-live region reachable by assistive technology

test_cases.title: Login token extraction matches AUTH-02's { token: string } response shape
test_cases.given: userApi.login(email, password) is mocked to resolve with { token: '<jwt>' }
test_cases.when: the login success handler processes the resolved value
test_cases.then: setAuthToken is called with exactly the token string field, with no other shape assumed
